newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeCrane started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeCrane started as a buy.

text.p: -- Dillon Read's John Pincavage said on Monday he initiated coverage of DeCrane Aircraft Holdings Inc, which makes avionics components, with a buy rating and a 12- to 18-month price target of $16 per share.

-- Pincavage said in a research note he expected the large number of aircraft deliveries planned over the next five years to give earnings visibility and stability to DeCrane's OEM manufacturing operations.

-- "DeCrane's avionics products are found in every new Boeing Co and Airbus Industrie, including flat panel displays, electrical contacts, connectors, wiring harnesses and support structures," Pincavage said in a note.
-- Dillon Read set a 1997 earnings estimate of $1.02 per share and a 1998 earnings estimate of $1.25 per share.
-- The firm said it expected earnings to grow 20 percent over the next five years, half from internal growth and half from acquisitions.
-- DeCrane Aircraft also provides avionics systems integration services in some niche markets of the commercial aircraft industry, Pincavage said.
-- DeCrane shares were trading up 3/8 at 12-1/8 by 0947 EDT/1347 GMT.
